reason: The preregistration declared 20 hierarchy episodes but its comparison text also required a static canonical rerun at the same five-step horizon. This amendment corrects the total arithmetic without changing models, tasks, seeds, prompts, metrics, or stopping rules.

oracle_commands.not_holding_cube: Reach for and firmly grasp the rubiks cube

holding_without_goal.left: Move the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl
holding_without_goal.right: Move the rubiks cube to the right of the bowl

oracle_commands.holding_at_goal: Open the gripper and release the rubiks cube

selection_predicates.requested_side: RoboLab robot-frame 45-degree left/right spatial predicate without requiring release
selection_predicates.cadence: The command is selected at every five-environment-step policy replan and the exact prompt plus oracle state are persisted in episode timing.command_history.

claim_boundary: The controller has privileged simulator predicates. It measures low-level response to a perfect command selector and is not evidence of learned hierarchical reasoning.
